svg.text: Perfboard layout: ESP32-C3 SuperMini, 33 × 19 hole board (straight wires)
Top: the front, where the parts go. Bottom: the back, where you solder, flipped left-to-right like turning the board over.
Holes are named letter + number, like on the board: S4 = row S, column 4.
SuperMini: pins in columns 16 and 22, rows R – K

button: legs F18 F20 C18 C20

The TFT pin order (GND at S4) and the
SuperMini pins (5V at R22, GPIO5 at
R16) match what you told me. Check them
against the printing on your boards.
The button and switch holes are my
guess: any holes work, just keep the
same legs on the same wires.
LiPo: goes on LAST, on kapton tape
Button leg D → board GND (C20 → Q22)
Real wires don't have to follow these lines:
keep them flat. A wire only joins a pin at
its ends. Board GND (Q22) takes wires 1, 3
and 5. Button leg D takes wires 5 and 17.
Seen from the back, the TFT is on the RIGHT and the OLED on the LEFT. Numbers run 33 → 1.
